en-US.description: An independent agent workspace and full harness for coding, research, and other project work.
en-US.longDescription: Varin is an independent agent workspace and full harness for coding, research, and other project work, centered on local and desktop experiences. It bundles the Pi runtime: the model and provider stack, session tree, package manager, and extension model remain Pi-owned, while Varin owns the surrounding tool environment, working state, recovery, retrieval, context policy, task governance, and workbench surfaces. Varin ships two first-party working shapes: an Agent Workspace centered on sessions, tasks, and context, and an IDE Workbench centered on editors, search, Git, diagnostics, and debugging with the agent as a dockable panel.
en-US.releaseNotes:
Varin 0.9.43 adds control over when collaboration messages and file exchanges reach an Agent, improves recipient selection, and fixes desktop authentication and chat layout issues.
Collaboration
- Choose whether a message reaches an Agent at its next model request or after its current run finishes. Pending messages can be sent immediately or withdrawn.
- Queue file exchanges until the receiving Agent finishes its current run. Queued exchanges retain the selected file versions, and the collaboration panel shows their participants, files and delivery state.
- Browse recipients in a scrolling list that automatically loads more members. Subtasks appear first, the main Agent remains selectable, and multiple recipients can be selected together. Load failures offer an inline retry.
Desktop and chat
- Fix a local desktop authentication path that could cause a 401 error when switching between Varin, Workbench and IDE or loading extension surfaces.
- Allow explicitly enabled LAN access without requiring a UI password. Password protection remains configurable, and clearing the password no longer turns LAN access off.
- Fix a recursive layout-update path in the chat virtual list that could trigger React error #185 with empty or collapsed rows. Preserve hidden-list measurements and existing scrolling and disclosure animations.
Builds and releases
- Separate platform-specific CI preparation and checks, and let container releases resume from previously built images while repeating qualification and smoke checks.
Desktop packages cover Windows x64/ARM64, Linux x64/ARM64 and macOS Apple Silicon. The signed Android APK connects to an existing Varin Host. Standard and toolbelt Docker images are published through the container release workflow.
Full changelog

zh-CN.description: 面向编程与科研的独立 Agent 工作台与完整 Harness。
zh-CN.longDescription: Varin 是一个独立的 Agent 工作台与完整 Harness，面向编程、科研和其他项目工作，以本地和桌面体验为中心。它内置 Pi 运行时；模型与提供商栈、会话树、包管理器和扩展模型仍由 Pi 提供，而 Varin 负责周围的工具环境、工作状态、恢复、检索、上下文策略、任务治理和工作台界面。Varin 自带两套官方工作形态：以会话、任务和上下文为中心的 Agent Workspace，以及以编辑器、搜索、Git、诊断和调试为中心、把智能体作为可停靠面板的 IDE Workbench。
zh-CN.name: Varin
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
Varin 0.9.43 支持选择协作消息与文件交换的交付时机，优化收件人选择，并修复桌面鉴权和聊天布局问题。
协作
- 发送消息时可选择「立即补充」或「本轮结束后」：前者在接收方下一次模型请求时带入，后者等待它当前整个任务回合结束。尚未处理的消息可以立即发送或撤回。
- 文件交换支持等待接收方当前回合结束后再应用。排队时固定本次选中的文件版本，协作面板可查看双方身份、文件和交付状态。
- 收件人改为可滚动、自动加载更多成员的列表。子任务优先排列，主 Agent 仍然可选，也可以一起多选；加载失败时可在列表内重试。
桌面与聊天
- 修复在 Varin、工作台和 IDE 之间切换，或加载扩展界面时，可能因本地桌面鉴权路径错误而出现的 401。
- 用户明确开启局域网访问后，可自行决定是否设置 UI 密码；清空密码也会保留已开启的局域网访问。
- 修复聊天虚拟列表在空行或折叠行下反复测量、更新布局，可能触发 React #185 崩溃的一条路径。保留隐藏列表的已测量高度，以及现有滚动和展开收起动效。
构建与发布
- 拆分各平台的 CI 准备与检查；容器发布可复用此前已构建的镜像继续执行，并重新完成资格检查与启动验收。
桌面安装包覆盖 Windows x64/ARM64、Linux x64/ARM64 和 macOS Apple Silicon；签名 Android APK 连接已有的 Varin Host 使用。标准环境与 toolbelt 环境的 Docker 镜像由容器发布流程交付。
完整改动
